title: Captions come from json3, and the fallback says so (R1013)
body:
All three slices of `docs/plans/oracle/json3-captions.md` (**OD-24**, **R1013**, from **BL-28**).

**One pull request for three slices, deliberately.** The blind test author put every slice's tests in one module, because the files the plan names still faked the pre-R1004 boundary at its base. Splitting would land two pull requests whose own tests fail. The per-slice scope is intact and stated below.

**A deviation from the plan's Files lists, stated up front.** All three slices name `tests/test_transcripts.py` as the test file. The blind author added `tests/test_json3_captions.py` instead and recorded why. Every other file in this diff is one the plan names. `tests/test_transcripts.py` is still touched, and its blind-written cases are unmodified.

### Slice 1 — a transcript comes from json3, and says so

`_caption_url` becomes `_caption_track`, returning the URL and the format together, preferring `json3` then `vtt`. `parse_json3` reads ONE CUE PER TEXT-BEARING EVENT: text is the concatenation of its segments verbatim, start is `tStartMs`. `Transcript.source_format` records the path and rides into the cache record; `load_cached` defaults it to `unknown` rather than guessing `vtt`.

`aAppend` events produce no cue, and **that is the correction this plan carries.** They are TEXT-FREE — all 2,257 measured carry a single newline — so they are the LINE BREAK. Dropping the break would fuse `we'regoing`, corrupting matching at every line boundary rather than merely shortening the text. OD-24 says they "carry real speech"; that sentence is wrong, `docs/DESIGN.oracle.md` is append-only, so the plan carries the correction. Accepted on #166.

### Slice 2 — the VTT fallback stops storing the duplication

`parse_vtt` drops roll-up display frames on parse. A cue extending the previous KEPT one is a frame; so is one wholly contained in it. Comparison is against the last surviving cue, not the last raw one — in `A`, `A B`, `B` the solo `B` is contained in its raw predecessor, so comparing against that would drop the line itself. The last line is kept explicitly: a closing frame's tail has no solo cue to follow it, and without that rule the last line of every fallback transcript would vanish silently.

### Slice 3 — the run says which path every video took

`fetch` reports how many transcripts came from each path, on every run including at zero, and calls the fallback out prominently when it was used — the owner's instruction was that a fallback must say so loudly. The counts describe THIS RUN: computed from the pending videos not already cached when the run began, never a walk of `data/transcripts/`, which would fold in a corpus no longer in the index and every plain cache hit.

### Two places the plan was wrong and the build corrected it

- `UNKNOWN_FORMAT` in `transcripts.py` and `JSON3`/`VTT` in `ytdlp.py` — the plan's placement is circular, and moving the constant away from the record it describes is worse. Deferred function-local imports resolve it.
- Slice 3's file list excludes `transcripts.py`, so `fetch_all` keeps its signature and the command derives the counts itself. My first attempt changed `fetch_all` to return a record, which the plan does not authorise. Reverted.

### Blind authorship

`Blind-Tests: json3-captions-1`. 75 cases, verified against a throwaway reference implementation under **eleven** deliberate mutations: no dedup, dedup against the raw predecessor, no last-line rule, two ways of stripping segments, keeping `aAppend` as a cue, fusing all events into one cue, taking the cue start from `tOffsetMs`, counts from a directory walk, no call-out, counts silent at zero, no report after a halt, payload sniffing, and a strict `source_format` read. It also caught that an earlier version of its own whitespace test survived one mutation, and tightened the fixture until only verbatim concatenation passes.

### Measured, on the real 285-video corpus

```
caption roll-up duplication: 2.84x across 285 of 285 transcripts
  stored 38,767,230 chars against 13,645,734 of speech
  json3 gives 73,159 chars where vtt gives 217,427 on the same track
  a VTT reconstruction lands within 0.05% of json3 — sound as a FALLBACK,
  which is why this keeps it
```

Nothing refetches automatically; R1004 forbids it. The corpus benefit arrives with the approved fresh fetch.

### Run locally against this diff

`pytest` 1255 passed; `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` clean; `mypy src tests` clean over 42 files; `plan-resolve.sh` resolves `docs/plans/oracle/json3-captions.md`; `blind-tests.sh` reports every blind-written test unmodified since its authoring commit; `acceptance-criteria.sh` ran 2, passed 2, including S9's double-run.

Rebuilt clean off `claude/template-lessons-merge-26dxdn` rather than carried on the stack it was written on — the stacked branch dragged 156 lines of a landed slice's `tests/test_aliases.py` with it, which is the contamination that blocked #164, #171 and #175.
